banner.title: THE FILE-PATCH SEAM - the ritual tooling extension: the spec-declared extra-file patches
banner.provenance: The R775 mounted-combat engine site (the last ungated UA deferred item) touches game/party.h and game/state_combat.cpp, and the R403 charge conditions in regtest must flip with the site - none of them land through the ritual as it stood. This round extends the engine (the file_patches spec key, gap-flip semantics: byte-exact anchors, one replace, idempotent, counted in the applied/already census), rverify (restore + count the patch targets at the base sha), and ./rn (the extra git-add paths derived from the spec). The three tools land by hand this once (the bootstrap note): the tool files cannot patch themselves; after R774 every file-patch round lands through the ritual like any other. The demo patch is comment-only in rules/mountlayer.h - the charge stays open until the site lands R775.
banner.sentinel: No book pages this round: the provenance is the tooling itself (the R428 one-command-harness precedent).
